text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was hectic right from the morning,
so I couldn't eat until after school, but—
choice_data_list: I don't think my stomach could handle any of that...
My stomach couldn't handle any of those...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's the matter, Trainer?
Aren't you gonna eat your food?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. You look pretty worn out.
It's not good to push yourself too hard, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When you've got no appetite, don't go forcin' yourself to eat.
You gotta let your stomach rest a bit, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here you go.
It's grated apple~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Apples are lovely little fruits that give your stomach a nice, healthy boost~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Don't rush, eat slo~wly, okay? That way, you'll get your energy right back.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm so happy you like it.
choice_data_list: I can feel the energy welling up inside me!
I feel like I've gotten my energy back!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, that's great to hear.
I'm happy I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know work can be tough,
so make sure to be kind to yourself once in a while, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Take a breather and breathe deep.
Taking time off from pushing yourself is important too, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Simmered daikon, cabbage soup,
and even boiled tofu are really gentle on the stomach~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm getting hungry.
Maybe I should grab some food too.
